description: This file defines the SectionStorageInterface, an interface for section storage plugins in Drupal's layout builder module, including method signatures for managing storage IDs, routes, URLs, contexts, labels, saving, applicability, and access control.

classes.name: SectionStorageInterface
classes.description: Interface for section storage plugins in Drupal's layout builder module, defining methods for managing storage identifiers, routes, URLs, contexts, labels, saving, applicability, and access control.

methods.name: getStorageId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the storage.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the type of storage, used with the storage ID.

methods.name: buildRoutes
methods.description: Provides routes needed for the Layout Builder UI, allowing route modifications during route building.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Gets the URL used when redirecting away from the Layout Builder UI.

methods.name: getLayoutBuilderUrl
methods.description: Gets the URL to display the Layout Builder UI, with an optional relationship type parameter.

methods.name: deriveContextsFromRoute
methods.description: Derives plugin contexts from route values during section storage instantiation.

methods.name: getContextsDuringPreview
methods.description: Gets plugin contexts for use during preview.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Gets the label for the section storage object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the section storage, returning a status constant.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines if the section storage is applicable for current contexts.

methods.name: getPluginDefinition
methods.description: Returns the section storage plugin definition.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access permissions for a given operation, optionally returning an object.
